text: The company register lists the holding GROUPE QUEGUINER (SIREN 482611761, SAS, Landivisiau) as Président de SAS of QUEGUINER MATERIAUX (SIREN 309540433), and Clément Quéguiner as Président de SAS of the holding, with Bertrand François Yves Quéguiner and Claude Quéguiner as its Directeurs Généraux. Groupe Quéguiner calls itself a family company for more than 75 years and a regional, independent group; its history page says Yves Quéguiner set up the business at Landivisiau in 1948 and that the third generation, Bertrand and Clément Quéguiner, joined the group in 2016.
short: Quéguiner Matériaux is chaired by the holding Groupe Quéguiner, a family company led by Clément Quéguiner.
